title: Initial Brainstorming Session
discussed: We discussed potential project ideas and settled on building an interactive quantum computing learning platform. The main goal is to make quantum concepts intuitive through visualizations and hands-on modules.

actionItems.text: Set up Next.js project with Three.js
Draft initial module list (intro, qubit, superposition, etc.)
Create wireframes for the main layout

title: Module Design & Content Planning
discussed: Reviewed the first draft of all quantum modules. Decided on the interactive approach: each module should have a video explanation, an interactive 3D visualization, and a quiz. We assigned topics to team members.

actionItems.text: Write quiz questions for all modules
Find and embed relevant YouTube videos for each topic
Design the sidebar navigation with progress tracking
